title: strom_piece_partition
body_html:
strom_piece_partition

Lean type

lean lemma strom_piece_partition (x : Fin n → ℝ) (hx : x ∈ stdSimplex ℝ (Fin n)) : (∀ i, MeasurableSet (strom_piece n x i)) ∧ (∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → Disjoint (strom_piece n x i) (strom_piece n x j)) ∧ (⋃ i, strom_piece n x i = Set.Ico 0 1)
